officialSources.observation: ESA states that digital maps can be requested with location, scale, layers, format and projection, followed by review and payment; this is a request/sales workflow, not an anonymous parcel API.
ESA official service index lists paper, digital and historical maps plus surveying services. No parcel viewer or public feature endpoint was exposed in the fetched HTML/current scripts.
ESA historical-map catalog is public, but the inspected catalog did not establish a current Bilbeis cadastral parcel layer or downloadable parcel geometry.
Official Sharqia Governorate bulletin mentions Bilbeis industrial-area land counts; it is administrative prose/statistics, not a parcel registry or geometry service.
